Editorial & Technical Review Policy

Every technical guide, symptom diagnostic page, and service guide published on Bara Electrical Servicing is authored or reviewed by Nick. Because electrical systems pose lethal shock and fire hazards, all guides strictly reflect current Victorian electrical legislation, AS/NZS 3000 standards, and manufacturer guidelines.

Homeowners are never advised to perform unlicensed electrical repairs. Under Victorian law, all fixed electrical wiring work must strictly be performed by an electrician holding an 'A' Grade licence working under a Registered Electrical Contractor (REC).
